title: Set All Practice (Administrator+)
body:
Syntax: setallprac who <skill or jutsu>
setallprac <skill or jutsu> <1-100>

Lists all current character percentages for a known skill/jutsu, or sets the selected percentage across all existing characters who have learned it, whether online, link-dead or offline. The change saves each affected character and marks the already-learned skill as practiced for normal first-practice gating. It never awards unknown skills or bypasses bloodline, village, class or level restrictions. Administrator and Implementor only.

Example: setallprac who shadow clone jutsu
Example: setallprac shadow clone jutsu 75

The normal who command continues to list online players.
